title: Art. 3.33.6 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 3 - Entry and Departure of Persons and Their Baggage, H. Inspection of travel documents, 3.33.6
content: Recommended Practice. Contracting States utilizing ABC systems should ensure that gates are adequately staffed while operational to ensure a smooth passenger flow and respond rapidly to safety and integrity concerns in the event of a system malfunction.
